content: The orthonormal basis vectors of $m_c$ -dimensional subspace ${Y}_c$ are obtained as the eigenvectors with the $m_c$ largest eigenvalues of the matrix ${R}_c$ . We represent a subspace ${Y}_c$ by the matrix ${Y}_c \in \mathbb {R}^{p \times m_c}$ , which has the corresponding orthonormal basis vectors as its column vectors.
